**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "founded in Bristol in 2019" | Allowlisted |
| "has become Bristol's favourite tea" | **Unsupported.** This is a superlative with no source. The 4.8/5 rating is not evidence of being Bristol's favourite. |
| "a small team of six" | Allowed (team size is a product fact under the policy) |
| "every tin is packed by hand in Bristol" | Allowlisted |
| "We buy from gardens we've visited." | **Unsupported.** Sourcing and visit claims aren't on the allowlist, and nothing in this chat backs them. Needs confirmation. |

**Other checks:** no ban-list words, no em-dash sandwiches, no exclamation points, no fake urgency, no health or green claims. The opening sentence is fine apart from the superlative.

**Suggested fix**

> Pebblebrook was founded in Bristol in 2019. We're a small team of six, and every tin is packed by hand in Bristol. [PROOF NEEDED: confirm which tea gardens the team has visited, and whether "we buy from gardens we've visited" holds for all of the range.]

If you can confirm the garden visits, name a few gardens, which is more concrete anyway. If you want a "favourite" line, it needs a source such as a local poll or award. Otherwise cut it. Don't publish until both are resolved.
